about: A Matter of Life and Death.
Blast through explosive waves of arcade action in this rapid-fire twin stick shooter.
As a hero-for-hire, survive high-intensity side-scrolling war zones in vertical cities overrun by mysterious “smart matter”.
Weaponize alien tech to destroy enemies infected by deadly Red Matter – and control Blue Matter to manipulate the world and create new areas to explore.
• Master extreme aerial agility and flying in zero G.
• Experiment with high-powered weapons to fight relentless enemies.
• Explore sprawling locations, including Matter Mines and Hydroponic Farms.
• Perfect your aim to grab the high scores and beat your friends in online leaderboards.
• Created by arcade experts Housemarque – makers of RESOGUN and Alienation.
• Enhanced for PS4™ Pro with dynamic 4K gaming, improved graphics and environments, and High Dynamic Range visuals*.
* Compatible 4K HDR TV required. Dynamic 4K gaming outputted by graphic rendering or upscaled to 4K resolution.
